about: Ratchet for src/__tests__/conformance.test.ts: what this server's TypeScript engine measures on the 4DA conformance corpus at the commit conformance.lock pins, truncated to 4 decimals, per OSV ecosystem. The test fails if any value falls or silent drops rise; raise them in the PR that improves them. Owned by this repository: the desktop app's Rust engine ratchets its own copy in 4DA (corpus README, rule 3). Landed 2026-10-12 (Stage A of the single-engine plan) after five reader fixes the first run found (CHANGELOG 6.2.2). unsupported_by_engine lists ecosystems whose lockfiles this engine does not read at all: scored and printed on every run, never asserted, never silently dropped.
